notes: Auto Cable: right-click an Access Point, IP Telephone, Printer, TV, switch or UPS to draw its cable to the nearest rack by route, the way you draw them by hand
View > Wall and Obstacle Map shows walls, doors, roads and obstacles the cable router uses
Object Library: hundreds of plan objects recognised, from seats and toilets to trucks, benches and boats
Cables connect only their two ends, plus racks, switches, splice boxes and manholes they run through, so the Excel export lists clean connections
Draw a Cable releases once a cable is finished
Cables and measurements inside an area can be right-clicked and deleted again
Saving retries when the file is briefly locked by another program
